title: Peruvian Duck Legs Confit
description: Tender and resinous, this traditional Peruvian dish features duck legs slow-cooked in a mixture of spices and sugar, resulting in a nostalgic and flavorful experience, with the added touch of Peruvian candy for a sweet and savory combination, all while being FODMAP-friendly.

ingredients.name: Peruvian candy
ingredients.notes: such as picarones or suspiro de limeña

instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together the sugar, salt, black pepper, cumin, and smoked paprika.
Rub the spice mixture all over the duck legs, making sure to coat them evenly.
Place the duck legs in a large Dutch oven or heavy pot with a lid, and add the Peruvian candy, duck fat, and chopped parsley.
Cover the pot with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Braise the duck legs for 2 1/2 hours, or until the meat is tender and falls off the bone.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Serve the duck legs warm, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
